children: Clarivate announced final results of a cash tender offer, accepting $75,000,000 of its 3.875% Senior Secured Notes due 2028.
Offer expired Sept 23, 2026; withdrawal rights expired at the same time, making tenders final.
Clarivate accepted $75,000,000 aggregate principal (the Maximum Amount) of Notes for purchase.
Total consideration per $1,000 principal was $975.15; accepted Notes were subject to proration at 11.3%.
Aggregate principal tendered was $665,198,000 against $825,000,000 outstanding prior to the Offer.
Settlement Date is Sept 25, 2026; accepted holders will also receive an accrued coupon payment.
